  "screen_decision": "include",
  "screen_rationale": "The text discusses the \"concordance rate\" of preclinical models with human clinical outcomes, citing \"Only 11% of published ‘landmark’ findings in oncology were validated in clinical trials\" and discusses \"predicting therapeutic safety\" and \"predicting heterogeneous patient responses\".",
  "arm": "methods-and-bias",
  "arm_evidence": "The paper discusses \"rigor and reproducibility\" and proposes \"robustness test\" to confirm results are \"robust across heterogeneous genetic contexts\", thereby improving prediction of likely responses in heterogeneous patient populations.",
  "therapeutic_areas": [
    "oncology",
    "hepatic",
    "cross-cutting"
  ],
  "areas_evidence": "The text mentions \"landmark findings in oncology\" and discusses \"acetaminophen-induced hepatotoxicity\" and \"liver injury\", and generally discusses \"translational medical research\" across diseases.",
  "model_type": "across-multiple-models",
  "model_evidence": "The text discusses \"genetically homogeneous preclinical models\", \"genetically ill-defined outbred animals\", \"heterogeneous preclinical populations\", and \"genetically heterogeneous mice\", implying a review of various model types.",
  "species": [
    "mouse"
  ],
  "species_evidence": "Mice are used as the \"exemplar given their extensive use in modeling therapeutic efficacy in human diseases\" and specific mouse strains (C57BL/6J, C57BL/6NJ, 129S1/SvImJ) are discussed.",
  "endpoint_class": "mixed",
  "endpoint_evidence": "The text discusses \"therapeutic efficacy\", \"safety\", \"adverse responses\", \"organ toxicity\" (hepatotoxicity), and \"tumorigenesis\", which encompass both hard and biomarker endpoints."
